title: Push-ups vs bench press: can push-ups build as much muscle? 💪
caption:
At a similar effort, studies found similar strength gains and muscle growth. The catch: make them hard enough. How many push-ups can you do? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 8
first_comment: Max push-ups in one go? Drop your number 👇
sources: Calatayud J et al. Bench press and push-up at comparable levels of muscle activity results in similar strength gains. J Strength Cond Res 2015;29:246-253
Kikuchi N, Nakazato K. Low-load bench press and push-up induce similar muscle hypertrophy and strength gain. J Exerc Sci Fit 2017;15:37-42
